notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.content: [p]Hi! It can now be confirmed that Akihabara - Feel the Rhythm Remixed fully supports the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p]Controls are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Navigate with the D-Pad[/p][/*][*][p]Select menu items with the Start or B button[/p][/*][*][p]Pause the game with the Start button. Select items in the pause menu with Start[/p][/*][/list][p][b]In-Game[/b][/p][list][*][p]Move the dropping icons with the D-Pad[/p][/*][*][p]Switch the icons with the A button[/p][/*][*][p]Tap the beat marker with the B button[/p][/*][*][p]Activate the super charge with the X button[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed bugs with achievement Destroyer Deluxe, and Blockography.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Some people have reported problems with the beat marker disappearing, or keeping on going for too long. There appeared to be an issue when using a gamepad that caused that to happened, it should be fixed now. So sorry for the inconvenience, if it still happens for any one, please let me know.
